label: Bible Study
prompt: I waited _____ for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verse: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
note: The waiting came first; the new song came a couple verses later.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Comfort your _____, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verse: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
note: Paul's prayer: that God would comfort your hearts and make you steady in every good word and work.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither _____ nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verse: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
note: The temple stones were cut off-site, so building it made no sound of hammer, axe, or iron tool.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy _____.
verse: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
note: Moses' boldest prayer; God answered by hiding him in a cleft of the rock and letting his goodness pass by.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without _____.
verse: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
note: Proverbs' most memorable image: beauty without 'discretion' is a gold ring in a pig's snout.
